_about: The runtime that cinestudio was tested on (2026-10-22, Windows + RTX 3070), pinned for a Linux GPU machine (setup/install_linux.sh). Node packs: only the ones the current graphs and scripts use (checked against ComfyUI's /object_info python_module of every node type in workflows/ and in the code). Change a pin only after a test run.

node_packs.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
node_packs.why: LTX-2.5 guiders, IC-LoRA loader and guides, AdaIN, latent select (the video)

node_packs.name: ComfyUI-segment-anything-2
node_packs.why: SAM 2.1 figure selection (shot mask); reads its weights only from <ComfyUI>/models/sam2

node_packs.name: comfyui_controlnet_aux
node_packs.why: DWPose (imported by cinestudio/video_passes.py, pose_people.py, motion_follow.py); the local copy was a download without git history: its pyproject.toml matches this 1.1.5 release commit

torch.note: cu130 (the default, the tested build) needs NVIDIA drivers >= 580. The cu128 index ends at torch 2.11 (checked 2026-10-24), so --cuda cu128 (drivers >= 570) installs torch 2.11.0: untested. The version is pinned: without a pin pip took the newest torch (2.14.1 on cu130).

sageattention.note: optional; cinestudio turns it on only for LTX-2.5 families (comfy.SAGE_FAMILIES): Qwen-Image-Edit drew all-black pictures with it

pod.image: a stock RunPod PyTorch image for CUDA 13.0 on Ubuntu 24.04 with Python 3.12+ (proposed: runpod/pytorch:1.4.2-rc.184-cu1300-torch2121-ubuntu2404); record its exact tag and digest here after the first successful test
pod.volume: a network volume mounted at /workspace for the models (8gb tier 155.6 GB, large tier 233.3 GB), the runtime and the cinestudio home: 200 GB (8gb) / 300 GB (large)
pod.access: the app listens on 127.0.0.1:8765: use an SSH tunnel (ssh -L 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 ...)
